text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The morning of the NHK Mile Cup, Fuji Kiseki asks the younger racer she hopes to inspire to watch her race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki tells her about the hopes she's placed on the mile tour and how she wants to deliver the best races possible. No matter the stage, it's the actors that make the show.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stands are filled with mixed feelings. There are people disappointed that Fuji Kiseki changed courses and fans who are wholeheartedly rooting for her. Her younger schoolmate is there too.
